summary: Executable models exist (BioModels search found a few coupled-cell or bistable membrane models; ModelDB lists 1,931 models; BETSE is open source, BSD-2-Clause) but I did not find a published model that combines voltage-gated channels with voltage-gated gap junctions, and the IUPHAR gating data sit behind an API key. Non-neural tissue data for the real mechanism are not covered.
next_step: Inspect BIOMD0000000373 and MODEL9810152478 for gap-junction gating terms, or assemble a minimal model from BETSE defaults plus connexin gating from the literature.
obstacles_confirmed: Most kinetic parameters come from neurons or heterologous cells, not the non-neural tissues in the claim.
Model attractors do not show that living non-neural tissue uses them as memory.
